_help: Per-crag profile for the dryness model (generate_dryness_html.py). Any crag missing here uses the defaults. aspect: N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW (which way the main wall faces). rock: limestone, granite, gneiss, conglomerate, sandstone. steep: true if the main routes overhang / are sheltered from direct rain. seeps: true if the crag is known to seep for days after heavy rain. Aspects for Podgorje, Damelj, Kotecnik, Buncove skale, Armesko and Luknja come from plezanje.net ('Usmerjenost').
